C1.metric: Precision@10 relative gain, hybrid vs. content-based-only AND hybrid vs. collaborative-only, warm-user held-out slice
C1.threshold: >= +0.10 relative against BOTH baselines, median over the 22 module-presentations, AND paired Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 0.05 after Holm correction for both comparisons
C1.on_dataset: OULAD, all 22 module-presentations, time-based split, identical splits for all four models

C2.metric: Precision@10 relative gain, hybrid vs. collaborative-only AND hybrid vs. content-based-only, cold-start slice built by refitting the similarity model without the held-out learners
C2.threshold: > 0 relative against BOTH baselines, median over the 22 module-presentations, AND paired Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 0.05 after Holm correction for both comparisons
C2.on_dataset: OULAD, all 22 module-presentations, cold-start-refit condition, identical splits for all four models

C3.metric: Cold-start Precision@10, hybrid vs. content-based-only and vs. a global-popularity baseline; non-degeneracy of the hybrid's top-10 lists
C3.threshold: >= content-based-only Precision@10 AND > popularity-baseline Precision@10 AND == 0 empty top-10 lists AND >= 10% of available items appearing across the slice's top-10 lists, in each of the 22 module-presentations

C4.metric: Tuning-on-test leakage count: rows shared between the validation split and the test split, and hyperparameters (blend weight, K, similarity cut-off) fitted on any data other than the validation split
C4.threshold: == 0 shared rows AND == 0 hyperparameters fitted outside the validation split; the test split is scored exactly once per model per module-presentation

C5.metric: Wall-clock time and hardware for the phase 2 main run and for the phase 1 reproduction
C5.threshold: <= 4.0 CPU-hours total for the main run over all 22 module-presentations AND <= 15 minutes for the phase 1 reproduction, on a single CPU with no GPU and no downloaded model weights
C5.reason: main-run conjunct only; the reproduction conjunct is decided by the pilot-stage run

values.process: single process plus one fresh-process worker for L7 (wall seconds counted as CPU, an upper bound)

C6.metric: Absolute difference between the reproduced phase 1 Precision@10 values and the recorded prior-evidence values, all three models, warm and cold-start, on EEE_2014J
C6.threshold: <= 1e-6 absolute for every one of the 6 values, with a run receipt carrying the SHA256 of the regenerated metrics file and the exact command line
C6.on_dataset: OULAD, module-presentation EEE_2014J, seed 42, deterministic selection rule
